name: discord-oidc-worker
description: Discord OIDC Wrapper in CF Workers

DISCORD_CLIENT_ID.description: Plain text. Enter the Application ID from your [Discord application](https://discord.com/developers/applications).

DISCORD_CLIENT_SECRET.description: Secret. Enter the OAuth2 client secret from your Discord application.

CLOUDFLARE_ACCESS_REDIRECT_URL.description: Plain text. Enter your Cloudflare Access callback URL, for example `https://<team>.cloudflareaccess.com/cdn-cgi/access/callback`.

DISCORD_GUILD_IDS.description: Optional plain text. Enter a JSON array of Discord guild ID strings to add role claims, or `[]` to disable role lookups.

DISCORD_TOKEN.description: Optional secret when `DISCORD_GUILD_IDS` is empty. Enter the Discord bot token used to read guild member roles.
